principle: Preserve complete, uncapped evidence. This is a Git storage gate, never an evidence-completeness exception.
expectedTotalEstimate: 15-40 MB for primary plus repeat, extrapolated from the committed 15-case baseline

gate.atOrBelow100MB: upload and verify the artifact, then stop; a separate owner-authorized post-run process commits the evidence
gate.above100MB: complete the run, upload the complete lossless evidence as a TEMPORARILY RETAINED workflow artifact, and stop before committing raw evidence to Git

reportedEitherWay: bytes by category: pass records, word records, line records, candidate records, manifests
ifTheGateFires: The evidence still exists in full as a workflow artifact. Only its commitment to Git is withheld, and that fact is reported rather than resolved by shrinking the evidence.
above100MBProcedure: upload the complete lossless evidence artifact
record the artifact ID, exact bytes, SHA-256, configured retention and expected expiration
require an explicit owner decision about durable archival before continuing
do not delete local job output before successful artifact upload AND digest verification
do not truncate, sample or destructively recompress

retentionLanguage.why: A workflow artifact is retention-bound and expires. Calling it permanent preservation would overstate what exists, and would let the evidence quietly disappear at expiry with the record still claiming it is safe.
retentionLanguage.permittedOnlyIf: a durable archival destination has actually been verified

priorDefect: The volume step exited nonzero BEFORE the verified upload. GitHub applies an implicit success() to any step whose if: contains no status-check function, so the verified upload was skipped — and the incomplete-forensic upload was skipped too, because its own condition is false when Actor 2 and Job C succeeded. A run producing 100 MB plus one byte would have detected the threshold and then discarded the only durable copy of the evidence.

atEverySize: upload the complete lossless evidence as a workflow artifact
record the artifact ID, exact byte size, SHA-256, retention and expiration
verify the uploaded artifact digest BEFORE deleting any job-local output
atOrBelow100MB: a separate owner-authorized post-run process downloads the artifact, verifies its digest, and commits the raw evidence to PR #219
that post-run process is NOT the OCR process
it has no access to governed truth until both raw manifests verify

stage1ExecutionStatus: The Stage 1 trusted freeze/staging generator and its temporary reproducibility mode have run. No Stage 2 Job A workflow, truth-free preparation artifact, runtime-bundle build, discovery, execute mode or governed 115-case acquisition OCR has run.
orderingIsFrozen: 3. the archive volume is MEASURED, nonfatally, into archive-volume-report.json
4. the complete lossless artifact is uploaded, regardless of the measurement
5. it is redownloaded by exact artifact ID, its metadata digest compared and its contents re-verified
6. the verification receipt is created and uploaded
7. ONLY THEN is the volume adjudicated
atTheLimitIsEligible: the rule is 'exceeds', so exactly 104857600 bytes is eligible
overLimitIsNotIncompleteEvidence: Complete, verified evidence above the limit is complete evidence. It is never uploaded under issue-149-incomplete-forensic-output.
overLimitMeans: do not commit raw evidence to Git
require an explicit owner durable-archive decision
preserve the retention-bound workflow artifact for that decision
